needs_human.note: Closing a DismissScrim menu by pressing on the Excel grid selects a cell (the library acts on mousedown) but does not activate the grid (the click is swallowed). The spec does not describe this case (R2).; The adapter now writes a private library field (`xs.sheet.focusing`) as well as reading it. If a library upgrade renamed it, both writes would silently do nothing, and the window paste, copy and key handlers would stay live after focus leaves the grid or after unmount.
The spec does not say what a press that closes a menu does to the Excel grid's active state, even when the press visibly selects a cell.
